title: Recorded metadata predicts the phenotype label across public single-cell cohorts and changes what internal validation can establish
description: Code, cohort metadata, metadata-variable inventories, donor-level analyses, per-seed outputs, simulation summaries, figures and manuscript assets for a PLOS Computational Biology submission on how recorded study metadata shape the validation of patient-level single-cell classifiers. Nine phenotype contrasts from five public blood datasets (809 donors) are screened with metadata-only classifiers by variable group (collection, demographic, sample quality) against cohort-specific permutation nulls; expression classifiers are evaluated with free and collection-stratified complete-pipeline permutations and by the increment of expression over metadata. All fitted pipelines share one fold-contained implementation (pipeline_core.py). The release also contains a 19,600-cohort simulation across seven regimes, calibration simulations, a decision-tree walkthrough, lupus deep-dive analyses and a retrospective CELLxGENE eligibility audit.
